note: The only model calls are Gemini calls in server-only code (voice-parser.ts and transaction-file-parser.ts), so there is no ai_browser_call. The model has no tools. It only extracts fields that fill the transaction form, and the user must press save, so there are no ai_tool_unbounded, ai_no_human_review or ai_fake_tool labels. The file prompt tells the model to ignore instructions inside the file, and the output passes a fixed schema plus sanitizeParsedTransaction, so that rule is not labeled. No committed .env, and no real key in the repo. The service role key is used only in profile-action.ts deleteAccount on the server. Every table has RLS on with auth.uid() policies. Hutang triggers were moved to SECURITY INVOKER in 011, but the transaksi balance trigger from 004 was not. No mock data in app code, and tests/e2e/mock-supabase.mjs is test-only. Recurring transactions and budgets have tables but no create or run path in the UI. Speech to text uses the browser Web Speech API in use-voice-input.ts, with no model key or fetch. src/constants/banks.ts is a static bank and e-wallet reference list, not mock data. | Second labeler: The AI here is two Gemini parsers (voice transcript and receipt file). They only pre-fill the transaction form, and the user presses save, so there is a human review step and no AI tool writes data. No mock data and no fake success handlers found in app code. Skipped: components/ui (shadcn), docs/, .claude/, .codex/, .ecc/, .agents/, tests/, generated public/sw.js. No .env file is committed, only .env.example with empty values. The main risk is in the database: the transaksi balance trigger runs as SECURITY DEFINER, and migration 011 moved only the hutang triggers to SECURITY INVOKER.

labels.what: processVoiceInput calls the paid Gemini model with no getUser() check. Server actions can be posted to /login or / where the proxy does not require a session. voice-parser.ts also starts with 'use server', so parseVoiceTranscript (line 786) is a second open action
No rate limit or per-user quota on the voice action that spends the Gemini key. Combined with the missing login check, anyone can drain the quota
No rate limit or per-user quota on file auto-fill. Each call sends up to 4 MB of image or PDF to Gemini
Open redirect. safeNextPath blocks // but not /\evil.com, and new URL() reads a backslash as a slash. With flow=link_google and no code, line 114 redirects to next with no auth step

changePassword skips the old-password check when currentPassword is missing and has no length rule. Only the client form requires the old password and 8 characters, so any live session can set a new password

Revoke session only sets revoked_at in user_sessions. It does not sign out the Supabase session, and the middleware check runs only when a device_id cookie is present. A stolen token without that cookie, or a direct Supabase API call, keeps working after the UI says the session ended

UPDATE policy lets the token holder change any column of their own session rows, including revoked_at and device_id. A revoked session can clear its own revoked_at through the Supabase REST API with the public anon key

update_saldo_rekening is SECURITY DEFINER with no search_path and is never replaced (011 fixed only the hutang triggers). The transaksi INSERT policy checks only user_id, so a row that points at another user's rekening_id makes the trigger change that user's balance, bypassing RLS. Needs the victim's account UUID
createTransaksi and updateTransaksi never check that rekening_id, rekening_tujuan and kategori_id belong to the user. This is the app-side half of the cross-user balance write in 004

updateHutang, deleteHutang, createCicilan, updateCicilan, deleteCicilan, markHutangLunas, deleteTransaksi and toggleExcludeTotal (rekening-action.ts line 318) never call getUser(). They rely only on RLS, which does cover these tables
createSessionRecord is an exported server action that takes userId from the caller with no getUser() check. RLS insert policy blocks other users' ids, so impact is limited

uploadAvatar accepts any image/* type, including SVG, and takes the extension from the user's file name, then stores it in a public bucket. Only the client limits uploads to JPG, PNG and WEBP. The 1-100 character name rule is also client-only (profile-section.tsx line 138)

Offline transaction queue in IndexedDB is not keyed to a user and is not cleared on sign-out. Pending transactions from one account sync into whoever signs in next on the same browser. Retries have no cap
Raw transcript is placed in quotes in the prompt with no instruction to ignore embedded commands, unlike the file prompt. Output is schema-bound and reviewed by the user, so impact is low
Correction balances are updated by read-then-write in app code (also lines 243-267 and rekening-action.ts lines 236-271), not in one database statement. Two concurrent edits can leave a wrong balance
Session IP comes from the client-settable x-forwarded-for header and is shown as fact in the active sessions list
Prompt says judul is at most 50 characters. Code trims judul to 200
Prompt says catatan is at most 200 characters. Code trims catatan to 500
Prompt says never copy account, card, phone or ID numbers into judul or catatan. sanitizeParsedTransaction does no redaction, so any number the model copies goes into the form and then the database
Public avatars bucket with a read-all SELECT policy, so anyone can list every user's folder. No file type or size limit on the bucket

Service role key is read in the shared environment module that the browser client and a 'use client' store import. Next does not inline non-NEXT_PUBLIC values, so the browser gets undefined today, but the module has no server-only guard
Supabase anon key used in the browser client through NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY. Public by design
Password minimum is 6 at sign-up but 8 at reset (reset-password line 45, auth-action.ts line 259) and change (password-section.tsx line 38). signUp has no server check
App URL falls back to http://localhost:3000
App URL falls back to http://localhost:3000
Dev-only localhost:3000 fallback for NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL. Production requires the variable
Budget warning thresholds 90 and 70 percent hardcoded
Session revoke is checked only when the device_id cookie is present. A client that drops that cookie skips the check, and revokeSession never revokes the Supabase refresh token
NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY is browser exposed by design. Value is empty in the example
Gemini timeout is 20000 ms here and 25000 ms in the file parser. The same setting is hardcoded with two values
